justification: A shows a single large bearded human head in strict profile with a tall headdress, patterned garment and detailed ear and eye, while B shows a spreading plant or tree with palmate fronds and curling tendrils, possibly flanked by small ornamental forms, with no human figure at all. The only correspondence is the general use of shallow incised low relief with tightly curled, repeated decorative units, which is too generic to indicate shared iconography.
